missions.title: Plan roles assigned only by billing
missions.objective: A paid plan grants its role only through the payment provider's verified webhook, never from the browser (ADR-0043 Decision 3).
risks: The payment provider is not chosen; nothing else in this mission can start before that decision.

tasks.title: Choose the payment provider
acceptanceCriteria: The owner records the provider and why

tasks.title: Webhook route that verifies the provider's signature
acceptanceCriteria: Unsigned or wrongly signed events are refused

tasks.title: Plan role written to app_metadata with an audit record
acceptanceCriteria: pro, business and enterprise are set only by the webhook
Every change records from, to, event and time

tasks.title: Retire the simulated checkout from every non-development path
acceptanceCriteria: Production builds cannot grant a plan role client-side

validationPlan: A signed test event from the provider grants the plan role

missions.title: Executive Office: wire the remaining preview parts

risks: Recommendations need a real source; until one is decided they stay marked as preview.
